search.$description: Single-line search field. No floating label at any size, unlike input/select — the placeholder simply vanishes the instant the field is focused, at sm/base/lg alike. Always has a leading search icon. A trailing clear (×) icon appears only once there's a value, to empty the field. No error state — a search box doesn't have a validation concept the way a form input/select does.

size.$description: Same grid as component.input.size, minus the label/labelGap fields — search never floats a label. value text is 16px at every size (see component-level $description) via the shared 'value' typography block below.

value.$description: One shared text style for placeholder/value at every size (16px, Safari-zoom-safe) — no per-size override needed since there's no floating label to coordinate with.

default.$description: Filled neutral field (fill.neutral = surface-4), no visible border — search is a filled affordance, deliberately NOT the recessed surface-0 + surface-6-outline look of input/select.

hover.$description: Adds the 12% lighten wash on top of the neutral fill — the exact hover move the neutral/ghost Button uses (fill.neutralHover = fill.neutral + lighten.2), not a border change.

focus.$description: A border appears on focus only (transparent at rest → outline.active); there's no label to colour.

populated.$description: Has typed text — the clear (×) ghost button becomes visible (see the clear block). Colours otherwise match default unless also focused.

clear.$description: Trailing clear (×) is a ghost icon button — transparent at rest, filling with a 12% lighten wash and whitening the icon on hover, exactly like the ghost Button. Deliberately NOT the blue-on-hover from the mockup. lighten.2 is used (a translucent overlay) rather than the baked fill.neutralHover so the button reads lighter than the field, which is itself already hovered underneath it.
